speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked	the Minister for Manpower (a) in 2017, how many mediations have been handled by the Tripartite Alliance for Dispute Management (TADM); (b) what have been the outcomes; and (c) when either party refuses to attend the mediation session, what are the options offered under TADM.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: A large majority of the disputes received by TADM are salary-related disputes which are governed under the Employment Claims Act (ECA), where mediation is compulsory.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: About 95% of these claims were filed by employees, and the remaining by employers for notice pay.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: These cases were then referred to the Employment Claims Tribunals (ECTs) for adjudication.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: One-third of the non-attendance cases were closed as the claimants themselves did not show up.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Where there are good grounds, ECT can and will make a payment order in favour of claimants, for the full claimed amount.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: As a consequence of non-attendance, ECT may also order the respondents to pay costs to the claimants.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Most of the remaining employees received some form of partial payment.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: First, is there any salary cap, or is it that any person can go and file their case at TADM?

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: The second question is, I have a resident who was referred to TADM and the employer did not turn up.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: TADM says that since the employer did not turn up, so they closed the case.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: But they should have referred the case to ECT, as the Second Minister mentioned just now.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: So, perhaps, better training should be given to the staff at TADM.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Instead of closing the case, we should see how best to help the claimant, in this case, the employee.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: In the case of the Member's resident, if there are some particular situations that we are not aware of, I invite the Member to let me know and we will look into it.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: What I meant is that a lot of employees are not aware that they can go to the tribunal.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: For the staff in TADM, instead of closing the case, they should have told the employees and advise them that they can file it with the tribunal.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: So, perhaps, there should be better training for the TADM staff so as to help the employees or the claimants.
